inventive_nucleus: A thin, flexible, and compressible silicone material is integrated into the staple line to provide real-time compression feedback.
structure: The compressible material is embedded within the staple line, extending from the staple's base to the tissue interface.
control_logic: Step 1: Measure tissue compression via compressible material deformation
Step 2: Compare measured compression to desired range (≤2 mm)
interaction: The compressible material interacts with the tissue, deforming in response to varying tissue compression.
operating_condition: During staple deployment, when tissue compression is variable.
failure_containment: The compressible material will deform and change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, providing a non-invasive and real-time measurement of tissue compression.
expected_effect: Consistent tissue compression (≤2 mm) before staple deployment.

inventive_nucleus: A miniature ultrasonic sensor is integrated into the stapler to measure tissue compression in real-time and adjust the firing mechanism accordingly.
structure: The ultrasonic sensor is mounted on the stapler's firing mechanism, emitting high-frequency sound waves towards the tissue interface.
control_logic: Step 1: Emit high-frequency sound waves towards tissue interface
Step 2: Measure reflected sound waves to determine tissue compression
interaction: The ultrasonic sensor interacts with the tissue, emitting and measuring high-frequency sound waves.
operating_condition: During staple deployment, when tissue compression is variable.
failure_containment: The ultrasonic sensor will accurately measure tissue compression and adjust the firing mechanism accordingly.
expected_effect: Consistent tissue compression (≤2 mm) before staple deployment.

inventive_nucleus: A shape-memory alloy (SMA) staple is developed to change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, providing real-time feedback.
structure: The SMA staple is designed with a unique shape that changes in response to temperature changes caused by varying tissue compression.
control_logic: Step 1: Measure temperature changes caused by tissue compression
Step 2: Determine staple shape change based on temperature measurement
interaction: The SMA staple interacts with the tissue, changing its shape in response to varying tissue compression.
operating_condition: During staple deployment, when tissue compression is variable.
failure_containment: The SMA staple will change its shape in response to varying tissue compression, indicating to the user whether the tissue compression is within the desired range.
expected_effect: Consistent tissue compression (≤2 mm) before staple deployment.
